description: Deletes an unsent draft outright — the draft page's own "Delete draft". Nothing was ever mailed or charged for it, so nothing is undone; a draft that has already been sent is a live event now and is archived with archive_event instead. Safe to repeat: a draft that is already gone answers ok. Needs the write permission.

draft_id.description: A draft_ id from create_event or list_events

title: Discard a draft
